full_name: Alexei Borodin | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Mathematics Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Alexei Borodin is a professor of mathematics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. He studies problems on the interface of representation theory and probability that link to combinatorics, random matrix theory, and integrable systems.
